_note: Fully synthetic values (no names, GPS, device serials or personal ids). The 'session' object of upstream garmin_mcp's activity_analysis._parse_fit for the original FIT file Garmin's download_activity(id, ORIGINAL) returns (fitparse applies the FIT profile scale). Pins the weekly steadiness inputs: total_ascent_m in meters, total_timer_time_s and total_elapsed_time_s in seconds, avg_power_w and normalized_power_w in watts (variability index = normalized / average power, a ratio; climbing = meters per hour).
